SQL:
WITH student_grades AS (
    SELECT ss.StudentID, st.StudLastName, ss.Grade,
           COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY ss.Grade DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rank_ge,
           COUNT(*) OVER () as total_students
    FROM Student_Schedules ss
    JOIN Students st ON ss.StudentID = st.StudentID
    JOIN Classes c ON ss.ClassID = c.ClassID
    JOIN Subjects sub ON c.SubjectID = sub.SubjectID
    WHERE sub.CategoryID = 'ENG' AND ss.ClassStatus = 2
)
SELECT StudLastName,
       rank_ge,
       total_students,
       rank_ge * 1.0 / total_students as quintile_value,
       CASE 
           WHEN rank_ge <= total_students * 0.2 THEN 'First'
           WHEN rank_ge <= total_students * 0.4 THEN 'Second'
           WHEN rank_ge <= total_students * 0.6 THEN 'Third'
           WHEN rank_ge <= total_students * 0.8 THEN 'Fourth'
           ELSE 'Fifth'
       END as Quintile
FROM student_grades
ORDER BY Quintile, rank_ge DESC
